[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1pt[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]End agent commit stages at a durable publication enqueue[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A no-conflict sase agent commit stage (provider done to done.json) [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]drops from a median of about four minutes to about one, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sase-core pin-only rebase conflicts stop costing an LLM repair [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]turn, while every sidecar write the commit path owes today is still[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]made. The agent's own declared commits stay synchronous and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]host-verified. Prompt-archive, agent-hood, Referenced By, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]artifact-link publication is durably queued before the stage ends, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]then drained by a host-owned background publisher, with today's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]inline drain as an automatic fallback.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]commit_stage_async_publication.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/commit_stage_async_publication.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-1pt[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-1pt/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop the fenced Referenced By loop and carry prompt citations [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]as link events[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]refby-events[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]refby-events: check the link-v2 fence before the lock, pull, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snapshot, emit prompt cites rows as publishable link events in fenced [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]projects, make referenced-by failures charge attempts, and handle the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]existing queued backlog.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Truthful commit-stage timing[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]measure[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]measure: emit stitch op_started before the subprocess runs and add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per-substep publication timing on the finalizer step channel.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Move artifact retention off the per-run tail[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]retention[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]retention: run enforce_artifact_retention from an hourly housekeeping [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]job and keep only a throttled inline fallback in the runner's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exec-finalize tail.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Resolve revision-pin rebase conflicts mechanically[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]pin-resolver[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pin-resolver: add a revision-pin resolver to the semantic rebase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]conflict chain that takes the descendant SHA when ancestry proves it, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]falling back to model repair otherwise.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make queued prompt-archive publication equivalent and [/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]protected[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]deferred-parity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after refby-events[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]deferred-parity: record the commit context on outbox rows, render [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deferred prompt archives exactly like the synchronous path including its[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]side effects, and stop pruning pool files that a pending request still [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]needs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Host-owned background publication job[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]publisher[dim] · [dim][/dim]after refby-events[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]publisher: add a doorbell-triggered scheduler job that drains agent-hood[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]requests, hinted link-outbox agents, and unfenced referenced-by requests[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]under the existing lock, plus a heartbeat and a real drain bound in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]secret scanner.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End the commit stage at the durable enqueue[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]enqueue-only[dim] · [dim][/dim]after measure, deferred-parity, publisher[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]enqueue-only: replace the commit path's prompt-archive publish and both [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drains with a durable enqueue plus publisher hints, ring the doorbell [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]after done.json, and keep the inline path as a config- and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]liveness-gated fallback.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Prove latency and sidecar reliability on athena[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]prove[dim] · [dim][/dim]after retention, pin-resolver, enqueue-only[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prove: after the installed sase includes the epic, measure commit-stage [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]latency against the baseline and audit every sampled run's sidecar [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]obligations end to end.[/#D7D7AF]
